fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX (SPCX) will have its 180-day IPO lockup expire on December 8, releasing approximately 797.6M shares (approximately $113B market cap, 5.9% of issued shares) for trading.
fields.summary_ko.1: SpaceX provided 2027 Q1 revenue guidance of $33–37B to drive earnings growth, but variables including additional 2027 lockup releases and weekly Starship launches exist.
